clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 15495 specifies requirements for water purifiers intended for household and similar use. Covers gravity-based, UV, UF, RO, and combination purification systems. The purified water output must conform to IS 10500 drinking water standards. ISI certification is available and recommended but not yet mandatorily required for water purifiers.

clauses.title: Performance Requirements
clauses.text:
Performance requirements for water purifiers:
- Bacterial reduction: ≥99.9% (log 3 reduction)
- Virus reduction: ≥99.99% (log 4 reduction) for UV/UF purifiers
- TDS reduction: For RO purifiers, output TDS shall be ≤50% of input TDS
- Flow rate: Minimum flow rate shall be declared and verified
- Filter/membrane life: Declared by manufacturer, verified by endurance testing
- Electrical safety: For powered purifiers, must conform to IS 302-2-15
